steps.content:
Both sellers are offering the **exact same product** for the **exact same price**, so **Ottervale Audio - Seller B** is the better choice because of its return policy.

**https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/t5hudq/b - Ottervale Audio**

Here is the comparison:

| | **A - Brackmoor Sound** | **B - Ottervale Audio** |
|---|---|---|
| **Product** | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - Graphite | Same |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days | Same |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty | Same |
| **Returns** | **30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping** | **Free 90-day returns** |

Everything else is identical - price, shipping speed/cost, warranty, specs, and seller rating.

**Why B is better:**

Seller B gives you **90 days vs 30 days** to return, and the **return shipping is free** vs you having to pay it with seller A. For headphones where fit, comfort, and noise-cancelling are hard to judge until you try them, that free, longer return window is much more buyer-friendly and risk-free. There is no downside to choosing B over A.
